campaignevents-rest-get-registration-inf: You are not participating in this event.
campaignevents-rest-register-for-event-n: Please complete your event registration on $1, the wiki where the event was created.
campaignevents-rest-delete-event-nonloca: Please delete your event registration on $1, the wiki where the event was created.
campaignevents-rest-email-participants-n: Please email participants on $1, the wiki where the event was created.
campaignevents-rest-contribution-not-fou: There is no contribution with this ID.
campaignevents-rest-delete-contribution-: You are not allowed to delete this contribution.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-id: The numeric ID of the event registration.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-contribut: The numeric ID of the event contribution record to delete.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-userid: The global central user ID of the user.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-event-pag: Title of the page for this event on the local wiki.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-timezone: Timezone identifier for the event times, in any format accepted by PHP's DateTimeZone.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-start-tim: Event start time in MediaWiki timestamp format (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), local to the timezone specified by the timezone parameter.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-end-time: Event end time in MediaWiki timestamp format (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), local to the timezone specified by the timezone parameter.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-types: One or more event type identifiers. Maximum 2 values.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-wikis: Wikis associated with this event. Pass ["*"] to include all wikis. Maximum 100 values.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-topics: Topics associated with this event. Maximum 5 values.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-online-me: Whether the event has an online meeting component.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-inperson-: Whether the event has an in-person meeting component.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-u: URL for the online meeting. Visible only to organizers and participants with the appropriate permissions.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-c: CLDR country code for the in-person meeting location.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-a: Street address for the in-person meeting location.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-chat-url: URL of the event's chat channel. Visible only to organizers and participants with the appropriate permissions.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-is-test-e: Whether this is a test event. Test events are excluded from statistics.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-tracks-co: Whether this event tracks wiki contributions made during the event period.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-goal-type: Metric type used to measure the event goal.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-goal-targ: Target value for the event goal (minimum 1).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-tracking-: Identifier of the external tracking tool. The only currently supported value is "wikimedia-pe-dashboard", for the Programs and Events Dashboard (https://outreachdashboard.wmflabs.org/).
Event identifier within the external tracking tool. For the Programs and Events Dashboard, this is the course slug from the dashboard URL (the path after /courses/).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-status: The new status for the event.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-is-privat: Whether to register as a private participant. Private registrations are not visible to other participants.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-show-cont: Whether to show the contribution association prompt to this participant after editing.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-answers: Answers to participant questions, as an object where each key is a question name and each value is an object with a "value" key (the chosen option) and an optional "other" key (free-text input for the chosen option).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-last-orga: The organizer ID of the last result from the previous page, for cursor-based pagination.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-organizer: List of usernames to set as organizers. Replaces the current organizer list entirely.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-include-p: Whether to include privately registered participants. Requires organizer permissions.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-last-part: The participant ID of the last result from the previous page, for cursor-based pagination.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-username-: Filter participants whose username contains this string.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-exclude-u: List of central user IDs to exclude from results.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-remove-pa: Central user IDs to remove. Pass null to target all participants (use with invert_users).
If true, remove all participants except those in user_ids.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-use: Central user IDs to include or exclude (depending on invert_users).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-inv: If true, send email to all participants except those in user_ids.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-mes: Body text of the email, plaintext only.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-ccme: Whether to send a copy of the email to the sender.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-question-: Restrict results to questions with these IDs. Returns all questions if omitted.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-language-: Language code to format the times in, in the format used internally by MediaWiki (similar to BCP 47 but with some differences).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-start-tim: Start timestamp in any format accepted by the MediaWiki timestamp parser.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-end-times: End timestamp in any format accepted by the MediaWiki timestamp parser.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-wiki: ID of the wiki where the revision was made.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-revid: Revision ID on the target wiki.
campaignevents-rest-patch-worklist-title: The worklist title must not contain an interwiki prefix or a section fragment.
campaignevents-rest-response-registratio: Event registration not found or deleted.
campaignevents-rest-response-email-accep: Email send job accepted. The sent count reflects emails dispatched.
